scope: deterministic fault injection; no paid-provider inference or charge

cases.name: inference_served_then_settlement_write_fails

cases.name: kill_after_reservation_before_settlement

cases.name: usage_unavailable
cases.proof: actual usage and Shilling totals remain null; estimated money hold is charged conservatively

cases.name: provider_model_failover
